scope: Primary-source text and one source-file review for a research and integration plan. No runtime integration, engine execution, video generation or empirical benchmark.

sources.title: Shutter Angles & Creative Control
sources.read_scope: Exposure, shutter angle, motion appearance and creative tradeoffs
sources.supports: Exposure duration changes motion smear and the crisp/staccato tradeoff.
sources.does_not_establish: A universally best shutter angle or reliable AIGC parameter execution.

sources.title: V-RAPTOR 8K VV Operation Guide: Shutter
sources.read_scope: Exposure conversions and recording frame-rate formula
sources.does_not_establish: Capture exposure can be inferred from generated-file FPS.

sources.title: Camera Panning Speed
sources.read_scope: Panning, image displacement and conditional cinematography guidance
sources.supports: Panning recommendations depend on shooting and viewing conditions.
sources.does_not_establish: A mandatory seven-second pan duration for all scenes.

sources.title: Setting Up Motion Blur
sources.read_scope: Velocity GBuffer, MRQ temporal samples and Niagara timestep discussion
sources.version_scope: Page served as Unreal Engine 5.8 documentation
sources.supports: Velocity reconstruction and temporal accumulation have distinct limitations and simulation dependencies.
sources.does_not_establish: All UE rendering paths behave identically or generative video runs Niagara.
sources.source_correction: The page equates 1.0/30 with 0.33333. Arithmetic gives approximately 0.033333 seconds. The decimal in the source is not adopted.

sources.title: Temporal Super Resolution
sources.read_scope: Troubleshooting Ghosting Issues, incorrect motion vectors and translucency
sources.version_scope: Page served as Unreal Engine 5.8 documentation
sources.supports: Investigate the stage producing ghosting and validate motion-vector behavior.
sources.does_not_establish: A generated-video artifact proves TSR is being used.

sources.title: Image to Video Prompting Guide
sources.read_scope: Image versus text responsibilities, motion cues and FAQ
sources.supports: Input-image motion cues can conflict with desired motion; text describes motion and temporal progression.
sources.does_not_establish: The examples guarantee equivalent behavior for every model or input.

sources.title: Gen-4 Video Prompting Guide
sources.read_scope: Prompting Basics, Best Practices, subject/scene/camera motion
sources.version_scope: Gen-4, not a universal rule for later versions
sources.supports: Simple concrete positive descriptions and incremental iteration.
sources.does_not_establish: Every video platform rejects negative inputs.

sources.title: Video generation prompt guide
sources.read_scope: Prompt elements, camera movement, optical effects, temporal pacing and negative prompts
sources.supports: Camera and temporal choices are distinct prompt elements; negative descriptions have model-specific guidance.
sources.does_not_establish: Precise shutter control through ordinary prose.

sources.title: After Effects: Time effects
sources.read_scope: Echo, Pixel Motion Blur and Timewarp
sources.supports: Temporal echo, motion-vector blur and retiming are distinct operations; samples and shutter influence different aspects.
sources.does_not_establish: Postprocessing repairs incorrect character identity, missing actions or impossible contacts.

sources.title: PostProcessing v2 MotionBlur.cs
sources.read_scope: Settings, camera flags, history reset and Render implementation in MotionBlur.cs
sources.version_scope: v2 branch; repository archived 2020-11-30; no immutable commit resolved
sources.supports: Shutter scaling, reconstruction sample count, depth/motion-vector inputs and history handling are distinct implementation concerns.
sources.does_not_establish: Current Unity package recommendation, compatibility, shader correctness or measured runtime quality.

sources.title: VBench
sources.read_scope: Evaluation dimensions and evaluation workflow documentation
sources.version_scope: README as accessed; no repository snapshot pinned
sources.supports: Separate temporal, consistency, motion and image-quality dimensions.
sources.does_not_establish: Our prompts have passed VBench or its general scores validate combat causality.

sources.title: Match camera motion to reference video
sources.read_scope: Camera movement reference workflow, model selection and stated purpose
sources.supports: The documented Firefly Video workflow includes camera-motion reference guidance.
sources.does_not_establish: Account-level availability, exact exposure transfer or identity/action replication.

evidence_limits: Read scope records the text consulted; embedded sample videos were not evaluated.
Online pages were not archived locally. URLs and access dates are pointers, not immutable snapshots.
Creative rules, examples and evaluation design are project proposals, not reported findings of these sources.
No third-party prompt success rates, guessed API parameters or model ranking claims were adopted.
